subject: Satellite Supper: guest curation, NDA triage & venue redlines
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Satellite Supper: guest curation, NDA triage & venue redlines

Team —

We're moving quickly on the NYC "Satellite Supper" (Nov 18 evening). Two asks to unblock:

1) Guest curation: attached is my current master invite CSV (invites_master_list_20261108.csv). Laura/Marissa, can you confirm final RSVP capacity (we have 28 seats after host comps) and flag 4 names that are strictly "no-plus-ones"? I want the short-list by EOD Monday so we can start invitations.

2) Legal/NDAs: DeepCloud has asked for a short mutual NDA for some pre-read materials. Neha — can you confirm whether we can use our 2026 events NDA template (attached) or if we should ask for a limited-scope addendum. They specifically called out data residency and photo release. If we need their counterparty contact, Sanjay Patel is the legal ops lead.

Also included: Kingston Venue's latest contract (redline v2) — there are two items I flagged: capacity clause (we need guarantee for 28 + 2 staff) and photography rights (they want upfront approval). Laura, please coordinate the venue redline with Kingston (contracts@kingstonvenue.com) and keep any changes focused on capacity and AV minimums.

I'll loop Olivia from DeepCloud once we have a clean NDA path — she asked for a list of attendees to confirm CE/industry reps.

Thanks — short bullets and a clear owner for each item will help.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

[Attachment: nda-template-redwood-2026.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
[Attachment: venue_contract_redline_kingston_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Satellite Supper: guest curation, NDA triage & venue redlines

Connor —

Thanks, this is helpful. Quick updates: capacity confirmed at 28 seats + 2 staff; AV minimums are negotiable but kitchen access fee is baked into the current cost. I'll mark four invitees as no-plus-ones in the CSV and remove three duplicates. Expect the cleaned list by Monday 2pm PT.

On the venue redlines, I'll propose the following limited language: "guaranteed seating for 28 guests plus two event staff; photography permitted for promotional use with written approval post-event; no commercial photography without prior consent." I'll elevate to contracts@kingstonvenue.com and ask for a response within 24 hours — copying you.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Events Producer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: invites_master_list_20261108-clean.csv (text/csv)]

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 07:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Satellite Supper: guest curation, NDA triage & venue redlines

Connor/Laura —

I reviewed the NDA template. High level: the template covers photo release and residency language but it's not mutual right now — our template gives Redwood the photo license, whereas DeepCloud is asking for mutual. Two options: (A) send our template and accept a short mutual counter if they ask, or (B) propose a one-paragraph addendum limited to "pre-read confidentiality and no retention of raw logs". Option B minimizes downstream legal review. Either way we should not sign anything that broadens data retention beyond 30 days.

If you prefer Option B, I can draft the one-paragraph addendum and feed it to Sanjay. cc'ing Vivek since he asked to be kept in the loop for any language that touches data.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: nda-template-redwood-2026.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: contracts@kingstonvenue.com
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, connor.obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:16:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Kingston Venue — redlines received

Hi Laura / Connor —

Thanks for the redline. We can confirm guaranteed seating for 28 + 2 staff. Regarding photography, we typically require venue sign-off for any promotional assets; happy to add a clause that requires written approval of images prior to external use, and we will not withhold approval unreasonably.

I've attached a cleaned PDF with our acceptance of the capacity language and a highlighted area for the photo approval wording. Please return the signed copy and we'll issue an amended invoice reflecting the guarantee.

Best,
Marcus 
Kingston Venue — Events & Contracts
[Attachment: kingston_contract_signed_capacity.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@deepcloud.ai>, Olivia Ramos <olivia.r@deepcloud.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Satellite Supper — quick attendee heads-up and NDA approach

Sanjay / Olivia —

Appreciate your team's interest in the supper. We're finalizing a very small guest list for Nov 18 (28 seats) and want to be respectful about what pre-read materials we share. Neha (counsel) recommends a one-paragraph mutual addendum limiting pre-read retention to 30 days and covering photo release. Would DeepCloud be OK with that approach? If so, Neha will send the addendum, and we can circulate a final attendee list (short bios) for your review.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm NDA addendum approach by EOD Monday (Sanjay)
- Laura to send updated invite list (Connor to share bios)
- Kingston venue will issue amended invoice after redline acceptance

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
